direction_of_travel: Military lull holds ahead of the November midterms — F9 (US large-scale strikes by Nov 10, p=28%) outpaces F8 (Iran-US deal by Oct 27, p=9%) — while Israel's October 27 vote narrows with F5 (Likud plurality, p=35%) and F10 (opposition bloc majority, p=35%) both reflecting a near-coin-flip outcome.
